name: the votes list is not a pageType
why: Without user-votes' match /user/<name>/votes gets no button (the spec asserts each list's own label).

name: the header fallback names only the first two lists
why: These pages have no <h1>; without the renameH2ToH1-keyed fallback headerContainer stays null and the script aborts before painting a button.

name: the @include admits only /edits and /edits/open
why: Tampermonkey would never inject the script on the other lists; the fixture harness injects unconditionally, so only the INCLUDE test can see it.

name: a list's title <h2> is not promoted
why: Without renameH2ToH1 the toolbar and the filter bar share the one native <h2> (DEBUG-NOTES.md 2026-07-29).
